customManagers.description: Versions pinned as ARGs in image/Dockerfile, each under a `# renovate:` comment (#39)

prBodyNotes: **Checksums:** update the matching `*_SHA256_*` / `CLAUDE_CODE_INTEGRITY` ARGs in this PR, from the project's own published checksums. The `image` workflow fails until they match.
**Live orgs:** an image change reaches each org only at its next restart. Announce it per org (CLAUDE.md).
